Ravi S: Quick ping 1 AP-701 postmortem actions overdue. Owners in tracker: @Lena K (SLO tuning), @Omar P (runbook handoff). Status?
Lena K: Sorry, blocked on the historical error budget export. Filed MET-120. Waiting on retention export from Observability.
Omar P: Runbook handoff draft is ready but I didn't get a reviewer. Leaving it as WIP in the repo: https://git.redwood.ai/org/repo/pull/823
alert-bot: Reminder: AP-701 actions overdue. Next escalation in 36h.
Ravi S: We need hard ETAs by EOD or I will reassign. This is the 4th incident with delayed SLO work this quarter.
SLO Lead: Noted pattern. Lena/Omar: please add explicit ETAs and blockers to the tracker now. If either cannot complete by Friday EOD I'll reassign to the on-call SRE.
Lena K: Adding ETA: MET-120 expected resolved by 2026-12-02 11:00 PT if retention export is granted.
Omar P: Asking @DevEx for review on the runbook PR, can you take a look today?
DevEx: On it, will review by 15:00 PT and leave comments.
Ravi S: Also proposing a preventive action: add "export access verified" checkbox to the postmortem template so SLO tuning isn't stalled by infra access. Please include in tracker.
Lena K: MET-120 got approval for export; I pulled the data and started calculations. ETA now 2026-12-02 14:00 PT.
DevEx: Reviewed PR, left two nits. LGTM after minor edits.
Omar P: Addressed nits and merged runbook PR. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/org/repo/pull/823
alert-bot: Closure verification scheduled for 2026-12-03 17:00 PT.
SLO Lead: Metrics validated and runbook in place. Marking AP-701 verified. Recording retro item: enforce "export access verified" and add to PM template.
Ravi S: Thanks team. I'll file the retro card and assign to Platform for process follow-up.
